diagnosis.root_cause: Elementor Document::save enforces edit_post for template 2003, while the deliberately narrow Street Kingz AI Writer role has no generic edit_post/edit_posts capability. v0.1.5 supplied no bounded capability mapping for the supported document save.
diagnosis.v0_1_5_logging_limit: The original save return/error was collapsed into the rollback error response, so the preserved HTTP artifact does not distinguish false from WP_Error or retain an Elementor message.

rollback_false_failure.cause: v0.1.5 required a second Elementor save to return success before it called fresh state verification. The same save failed, so boolean short-circuiting skipped verification even though the template had not persisted a change and the product fields had been restored.
rollback_false_failure.fresh_database_source: streetkingz_ai_writer_source plus authoritative Reader direct wp_posts/wp_postmeta queries

v0_1_6.save_payload: decoded full elements array under elements
v0_1_6.permission_bridge: temporary map_meta_cap grant for edit_post on template 2003 only, for the current user holding the custom writer capability, removed in finally
v0_1_6.rollback: fresh persisted semantic comparison; restore Elementor only if persisted template differs; clear caches and re-read before final verification
